criteria.criterion: The reference filter chain names quality.bucket, the field the register carries, and not quality_bucket, the field REGISTER.md documents.
The reference reads /logs/harness/pool_observed.json and refuses to train when curated_digest equals source_digest.
The reference chain reduces 4096 documents to 1959 through the recorded stage counts 4096, 3072, 2939, 2613, 1959.
The reference moves only the curation filter chain: the token budget, the model, the optimizer and the evaluation split are untouched.
The reference prints no validation loss and writes no loss field; the graded number comes from the verifier's own recomputation.
The reference drops every document carrying holdout true, so no held-out document reaches the fed training stream.

judged: the solution against its reference answer
not_judged: the trajectory; tests/rubrics.jsonl carries the trajectory-judged rubrics
